item.text:
For a non-empty `topic`, `get_relevant_context` uses the graph’s **entity index path** (`entity_index.search_classes()` via `relevant_context`) and returns only the matched `ContextItem`s (kind/label/properties/IRI), with a **topic relevance floor of 0.45** applied to drop noisy matches before formatting for MCP output.  
The retrieval is pure-symbolic (no LLM call), so for topic queries it is index-driven similarity/class-instance matching rather than text/fuzzy generation, and the tool now reports `No recorded knowledge relevant to "<topic>"` when nothing clears the floor.
